extensionAttribute.description: Returns the homepage URL set in Firefox's prefs.js for the current/last console user.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Firefox Homepage Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe)
user=$(/usr/sbin/scutil <<< "show State:/Users/ConsoleUser" 2>/dev/null \ | /usr/bin/awk '/Name :/ && ! /loginwindow/ { print $3; exit }') [[ -z "$user" || "$user" == "root" ]] && user=$(/usr/bin/defaults read /Library/Preferences/com.apple.loginwindow lastUserName 2>/dev/null)
home=$(/usr/bin/dscl . -read "/Users/$user" NFSHomeDirectory 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/awk '{print $2}') profilesDir="$home/Library/Application Support/Firefox/Profiles"
if [[ ! -d "$profilesDir" ]]; then echo "<result>Not Installed</result>" exit 0 fi
profile=$(/bin/ls "$profilesDir" 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/grep -m1 '\.default') prefs="$profilesDir/$profile/prefs.js"
if [[ -f "$prefs" ]]; then hp=$(/usr/bin/awk -F'"' '/browser\.startup\.homepage/ { print $4; exit }' "$prefs") echo "<result>${hp:-Not Set}</result>" else echo "<result>Not Set</result>" fi
